Priority: high
Async drain A6, last part: return a held-back candidate to its producer, and stop thrashing
Depends on 20261031-031749-am9j

After 20261031-031749-am9j, a candidate whose own landing commit conflicts with main is held back and ends. Instead, send it back to its producer once with the conflict named, re-run its checks and verifier, and queue it again (docs/design/async-drain.md, the A6 row of the build plan and section 6). Apply the thrash stop of section 6: when the same item is held back twice, end it as failed and do not stop the drain.

Acceptance:
- A drain test: a held-back candidate goes back to its producer once, with the conflicting paths in its brief, and lands after a clean second pass.
- A drain test: a second hold-back of the same item ends it as failed, and the next candidate still lands.
- With max_in_flight = 1 the existing drain tests pass unchanged.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Files: crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, docs/design/async-drain.md, CHANGELOG.md
